fields.summary: TC-748-02: First and Last Flight Time Fields Reference Correct Version When Original Flight Data Exists in Prior Version

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-748

Precondition: A trip has been through a Save and Replace creating V0 and V1. V0 contains the original flight data. V1 has updated legs. The first/last flight time fields must reference the version containing original flight-related timings per the COA versioning rules.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Create trip V0 with original legs and record the first/last flight datetimes
V0: DAL->HOU dep 08:00Z arr 09:30Z (first and last leg). coaTripFirstFltDtm=08:00Z, coaTripLastFltDtm=09:30Z
V0 COA record contains coaTripFirstFltDtm=08:00Z and coaTripLastFltDtm=09:30Z
Trigger an involuntary Save and Replace creating V1 with different flight legs and timings
V1: DAL->AUS dep 10:00Z arr 11:30Z (replacement legs, changeType=INVOL)
V1 is created with new legs and different flight timings
Trigger the COA Step Function to process V1
COA Step Function processing V1 of the trip
Step Function processes V1 and updates the COA record
Verify that coaTripFirstFltDtm and coaTripLastFltDtm reference the version containing original flight data (V0)
V0 had original flight DAL->HOU dep 08:00Z arr 09:30Z. V1 has replacement DAL->AUS dep 10:00Z arr 11:30Z
coaTripFirstFltDtm references V0 original departure (08:00Z). coaTripLastFltDtm references V0 original arrival (09:30Z)
Verify the Analytics Schema and COA Search App display the correct version-referenced first/last flight times
COA Search App and Analytical Schema for the trip after V1 processing
Both COA Search App and Analytical Schema show coaTripFirstFltDtm=08:00Z and coaTripLastFltDtm=09:30Z (from V0 original)
